formate.intro: DELE A1 has four papers. The result is Apto or No apto (pass or fail). As far as we could check, the four papers are marked in two groups of 50 points, and you need at least 30 points in each group: a strong group cannot make up for a weak one. Check the rule in the current exam guide.
